{{Quote|How much longer do we have on that shield?"<br />"Midi-secs, sir."<br />"That's all we have.|The ARC commander and the ARC trooper|<ref name="One Battle" />}}
A [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] '''Advanced Recon Commando''' served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and took part in the [[Battle of Aridka]]. During the battle, the [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper's]] squad was nothing more than a handful of clone troopers in a trench with an [[Ray shield/Legends|energy shield]]. The ARC trooper attempted to send a call for reinforcements, but he believed that it had been lost in a magnetic storm. At the behest of their [[Unidentified Advanced Recon Commando commander (Aridka)|commander]], the clone troopers put up a last stand against the overwhelming [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] army. After sustaining several [[Death/Legends|casualties]], the clones were reinforced by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]. With the combined efforts of Koon and the clones, the battle was won by the Republic.<ref name="One Battle" />
